// ice block — 20261108-000000-000000-test@1
// Target: three.js ShaderMaterial (three r187)
// Uniforms: iResolution (pixels), iTime (seconds), iTimeDelta, iFrame, iMouse, iDate; fragCoord is in pixels, origin bottom left.
// Sliders: none
// Provenance: origin agent
// Licence: unknown (private; the author has not chosen one)
// Made with Shaderbrücke — https://github.com/studioluftbruecke/shaderbruecke

import * as THREE from 'three'

/** The shader's fragment source. Edit the uniforms, not this string. */
export const fragmentShader = `// ice block — 20261108-000000-000000-test@1
// Target: three.js ShaderMaterial (three r187)
// Uniforms: iResolution (pixels), iTime (seconds), iTimeDelta, iFrame, iMouse, iDate; fragCoord is in pixels, origin bottom left.
// Sliders: none
// Provenance: origin agent
// Licence: unknown (private; the author has not chosen one)
// Made with Shaderbrücke — https://github.com/studioluftbruecke/shaderbruecke

precision highp float;
precision highp int;
uniform vec3 iResolution;
uniform float iTime;
uniform float iTimeDelta;
uniform int iFrame;
uniform vec4 iMouse;
uniform vec4 iDate;
out vec4 fragColor;

// Raymarched ice block: a rotating box SDF with a rim light and a floor plane.
// Constant loop bounds only; every march is capped at 64 steps.

float sdBox(vec3 p, vec3 b) {
  vec3 q = abs(p) - b;
  return length(max(q, 0.0)) + min(max(q.x, max(q.y, q.z)), 0.0);
}

float map(vec3 p) {
  vec3 q = p;
  float a = iTime * 0.4;
  q.xz = mat2(cos(a), -sin(a), sin(a), cos(a)) * q.xz;
  float box = sdBox(q, vec3(0.55, 0.55, 0.55)) - 0.08;
  float floorPlane = p.y + 0.95;
  return min(box, floorPlane);
}

vec3 normalAt(vec3 p) {
  vec2 e = vec2(0.002, 0.0);
  return normalize(vec3(map(p + e.xyy) - map(p - e.xyy),
                        map(p + e.yxy) - map(p - e.yxy),
                        map(p + e.yyx) - map(p - e.yyx)));
}

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
  vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
  vec3 ro = vec3(0.0, 0.2, 2.6);
  vec3 rd = normalize(vec3(uv, -1.6));

  float t = 0.0;
  float hit = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
    float d = map(p);
    if (d < 0.001) {
      hit = 1.0;
      break;
    }
    t += d * 0.85;
    if (t > 8.0) {
      break;
    }
  }

  vec3 col = mix(vec3(0.05, 0.07, 0.12), vec3(0.30, 0.38, 0.52), uv.y + 0.5);
  if (hit > 0.5) {
    vec3 p = ro + rd * t;
    vec3 n = normalAt(p);
    vec3 lightDir = normalize(vec3(0.6, 0.8, 0.3));
    float diffuse = max(dot(n, lightDir), 0.0);
    float rim = pow(1.0 - max(dot(n, -rd), 0.0), 2.5);
    vec3 base = vec3(0.62, 0.82, 0.92);
    col = base * (0.18 + 0.82 * diffuse) + vec3(0.7, 0.9, 1.0) * rim * 0.55;
    col *= exp(-0.12 * t);
  }

  fragColor = vec4(pow(col, vec3(1.0 / 2.2)), 1.0);
}

void main() {
  vec4 color = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  mainImage(color, gl_FragCoord.xy);
  fragColor = color;
}
`

const vertexShader = `
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); }
`

/**
 * Create the ice block material.

 * @returns {THREE.ShaderMaterial} call `setSize(width, height)` and `update(seconds)` each frame
 */
export function createIceBlockMaterial(options = {}) {
  const uniforms = {
    iResolution: { value: new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1) },
    iTime: { value: 0 },
    iTimeDelta: { value: 1 / 60 },
    iFrame: { value: 0 },
    iMouse: { value: new THREE.Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0) },
    iDate: { value: new THREE.Vector4() },

  }
  const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    glslVersion: THREE.GLSL3,
    uniforms,
    vertexShader,
    fragmentShader,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false
  })
  material.setSize = (width, height) => uniforms.iResolution.value.set(width, height, 1)
  material.update = (seconds) => {
    uniforms.iTime.value = seconds
    uniforms.iFrame.value = Math.round(seconds * 60)
    uniforms.iTimeDelta.value = 1 / 60
  }
  return material
}
